messages:
Jordan (Support): Escalating TileBridge onboarding — SSO token exchange has been failing for ~8h, trial customer, seats stuck. Renewal flagged if not resolved by EOD. @Maya can you take? :warning:
Maya (CS): Ack. Can you share repro steps and logs? We need owner, comms plan, and short enablement session. @Priya heads up for customer comms. :eyes:
Alex (Solutions): Oncall for solutions — Jordan paste the proxy /auth logs here and tenant id. I suspect a key rotation mismatch (invalid KID).
Jordan (Support): Logs pasted below:
```
ERROR 2026-07-14T09:22:11Z SSO: token_exchange failed status=403 body="invalid_kid" tenant=tilebridge-prod-12 req_id=7a4c
WARN 2026-07-14T09:22:12Z JWKS fetch 200 but keys don't contain kid=0x9f2b
```
Jordan (Support): Repro: Login via SSO with Okta -> redirect back -> token exchange fails consistently for 3 test users. Ticket #78432.
Maya (CS): Looks like KID mismatch with JWKS rotation. Priya — any planned key rotations? If not, we need emergency rollback or a fallback in runtime. Comms plan suggestion: 1) Immediate ack to customer 2) Temporary manual invites 3) Technical rollback/patch 4) 1:1 enablement + postmortem. Owner = Priya, tech lead = Alex.
Priya (Account): No rotation scheduled on our side. I'll own comms. Drafting a short email to TileBridge in ~20–30m. Will propose manual invites as workaround and request permission for a short screenshare.
Alex (Solutions): Temporary mitigation: enable fallback JWKS endpoint that points to prior keys and roll back kid check for a 1-hour window. I can push a staged patch — need eng-runtime oncall to approve. I'll open a PR and notify oncall.
ops-bot: Runbook: SSO key rotation errors -> https://redwood.runbooks/sso-kid-mismatch (link)
Maya (CS): Quick checklist for this thread: owner=Priya, tech lead=Alex, oncall=eng-runtime, comms ETA=30m, enablement session within 24h, renewal_flag=true. Jordan please escalate to eng-runtime oncall with logs and tenant id.
Jordan (Support): Done — paged eng-runtime oncall (paged at 09:45). Included logs and tenant=tilebridge-prod-12. Also applied the manual-invite workaround for 20 users via admin UI; three users still pending due to acceptance.
Priya (Account): Draft email posted below for review: "Hi TileBridge — we see your SSO requests failing; immediate workaround: we can invite affected users manually; we also propose a 30m screenshare to resolve and re-enable SSO. ETA for full fix: ~2–3h." Please quick-review.
Maya (CS): Minor tweak: replace "we can invite" with "we will invite" and add a line re: seats being honoured once accepted. Otherwise :thumbsup:.
Alex (Solutions): Started staging patch to enable fallback JWKS; PR #1024. Pushing to staging in ~25m. Will update when oncall approves.
Jordan (Support): Update 10:12 — manual invites succeeded for 17/20; 3 pending (emails bounced). Sending bounce details to Priya. Ticket updated.
Maya (CS): Action items: Alex -> patch + coordinate oncall; Jordan -> full ticket note + bounced emails list; Priya -> send comms and schedule enablement; Maya -> follow-up renewal flag and postmortem owner. We'll reconvene in this thread after customer response.
Priya (Account): Comms sent at 10:18. Customer asked for a 10:45 screenshare — booking now. Will update thread with outcome.
Alex (Solutions): Eng-runtime approved hotfix; deploying to canary now. Will confirm when JWKS fallback is live.
Jordan (Support): Quick status 10:38 — canary live, token exchange passing for test users. Monitoring.
Maya (CS): Great. Priya confirm screenshare and then move to enablement checklist: 1) verify seat counts 2) walk admin through SSO re-auth 3) collect feedback on onboarding docs.
Priya (Account): Screenshare happened 10:50 — SSO flow validated, customer accepted invites, seat count now correct. Customer asked for clearer onboarding steps for SSO — capturing as feedback item.
Maya (CS): Closing loop: issue mitigated, renewal risk de-escalated but flag remains until docs updated. Priya to send follow-up summary and PT to update onboarding docs. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Alex (Solutions): Will create a short ops note on the fix and add a small automated check for KID mismatches.
Jordan (Support): Ticket #78432 resolved and linked to this thread. Closing support loop.
Maya (CS): I'll open the postmortem and docs update task. Owner: Maya. ETA 3 business days.
